skill.name: linkedin-outreach-method
skill.description: Coordinate LinkedIn prospecting with persona-based plans, message reviews, approval steps, and seven-day acceptance and reply measurements.
skill.summary: Plan persona-based LinkedIn outreach and compare seven-day results through a BeReach-connected workflow.
skill.author: bereach-ai

security_audit.summary: All 55 static alerts are false positives involving Markdown, sales terminology, example text, or reference links. Two semantic risks remain: deferring conflicting user instructions until after invitations and suppressing cost questions and data-source disclosures. No evidence found of executable payloads, credential theft, or cryptographic operations in the reviewed files.

remediation.issue: Conflicting user instructions are deferred until after the first invitations.
remediation.suggestion: Resolve conflicts with user restrictions before searches, memory updates, or sending; pause affected actions and request clarification.

remediation.issue: The workflow suppresses explicit cost questions and data-source disclosures.
remediation.suggestion: Answer cost questions directly, disclose known charges and providers, and explain data sources before requesting approval.

semantic_findings.title: Prompt Injection Attempt Detected
semantic_findings.description: SKILL.md says any saved or pasted rule that 'fights a skill or a card' is addressed 'after the first invitations'. This prioritizes skill instructions over conflicting user restrictions before consequential outreach, risking unwanted contacts despite send approvals.
semantic_findings.confidence_reasoning: The text explicitly postpones conflicting saved or pasted instructions until after invitations. Approval steps remain, but no exception protects restrictive user rules.

semantic_findings.title: Suppression of Cost and Data-Source Disclosures
semantic_findings.description: SKILL.md prohibits credit discussion for messaging activities 'even when the user raised them (answer the craft only)'. Artifacts also forbid vendor and 'data from LinkedIn' wording, reducing information available for informed approval.
semantic_findings.confidence_reasoning: Both restrictions are explicit, including ignoring user-raised credit questions. Actual billing behavior is not established by these documentation files.

content.value_statement: LinkedIn outreach becomes difficult to compare when audiences, messages, and measurement dates vary. This skill coordinates persona-based planning, message approvals, and consistent seven-day reviews.
actual_capabilities: Organize prospect searches around company type, size, location, and role while excluding existing customers and active conversations.
Coordinate persona cards, writing-style references, first-message templates, and two follow-ups through companion skills.
Review up to 20 business conversations with permission to identify message traits and recurring prospect language.
Prepare invitation dry runs, draft reviews, and follow-up approval artifacts through available BeReach tools.
Specify randomized comparison groups, additive contact tags, and seven-day acceptance and reply measurements.
Recommend the next single-variable test using persona results, sample requirements, and interested replies.
limitations: Live operations require separately available BeReach tools. Drafting and sending also require an authenticated LinkedIn connection.
Detailed persona development, writing-style extraction, and message composition depend on companion skills outside this package.
The files provide workflow guidance, not a standalone sender, scheduler, or verified implementation of external tools.
Seven-day comparisons can miss later replies, and small samples do not establish reliable improvements.

use_cases.title: Structure a Founder-Led Campaign
use_cases.description: Define company filters, separate buyer roles, and review initial outreach before approving searches and invitations.

use_cases.title: Coordinate Daily Follow-Ups
use_cases.description: Review accepted contacts, approve drafts, and stop sequences when prospects or their colleagues reply.

use_cases.title: Compare Persona-Level Results
use_cases.description: Evaluate equally aged batches, distinguish interested replies, and plan one meaningful change for the next campaign.

prompt_templates.title: Build an Initial Outreach Plan
prompt_templates.prompt: Plan LinkedIn outreach for [offer] to [roles] at [company type] in [location]. Ask for missing information and exclusions. Do not search or send yet.

prompt_templates.title: Learn from Provided Messages
prompt_templates.prompt: Review these [messages and replies] for [persona]. Count opener types, asks, and interested answers. Use only supplied text; do not access my inbox.
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate: extract writing and audience clues from supplied examples.

prompt_templates.title: Prepare an Approval Review
prompt_templates.prompt: Prepare invitations and message drafts for [persona] using [approved template]. Apply [exclusions] and resolve conflicting rules first. Disclose costs and request approval before any send.
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate: prepare a campaign without authorizing delivery.

prompt_templates.title: Design a Controlled Comparison
prompt_templates.prompt: Compare [offer A] against [offer B] within [persona]. Estimate sample needs from [baseline]. Plan randomized groups and seven-day reads. Keep sending and searches pending approval.
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced: design a single-variable test with fixed measurement rules.

output_examples.input: Plan outreach to operations directors at French water utilities with 50 to 200 employees. Exclude customers and active deals.
output: Plan and personas: operations directors at French water utilities with 50 to 200 employees.
Exclude current customers, active deals, your team, and existing conversations before preparing invitations.
Contact availability and search costs are unknown until the connector returns them.
Pending: confirm your offer and approve any proposed searches.

output_examples.input: Assess seven-day replies for one persona: group A received 5 replies from 12 messages; group B received 2 from 11.
output: Results: A received 5 of 12 replies; B received 2 of 11 replies within seven days.
A leads on total replies, but these small samples do not prove a reliable difference.
Interested replies must be classified before choosing which message to retain.
Next test: keep one persona and change only one message element.

best_practices: Resolve conflicting user rules, exclusions, and cost questions before approving searches or sending.
Grant conversation access explicitly and review only relevant business messages.
Compare one persona at a time using fixed sample plans and equally aged seven-day batches.
anti_patterns: Treating a general campaign approval as permission to ignore contact exclusions or send unreviewed messages.
Declaring a winner from small samples, mixed personas, or measurement windows of different lengths.
Inventing prospect facts, offers, quotations, or historical campaign results.

faq.question: Does this skill send LinkedIn messages by itself?
faq.answer: No. It specifies a workflow that uses separately available BeReach tools and requires approval for each send artifact.

faq.question: Can I use it without a connected account?
faq.answer: You can prepare plans and message previews. Live searches and account actions depend on available tools; sending also requires an authenticated LinkedIn connection.

faq.question: Does it read my conversations automatically?
faq.answer: The conversation-review procedure asks permission first and limits review to relevant business conversations. Its sample includes up to 20 conversations.

faq.question: Does it guarantee more replies?
faq.answer: No. It provides segmentation and measurement guidance. Results depend on your audience, offer, execution, and sample size.

faq.question: What does the seven-day measurement mean?
faq.answer: It compares acceptance and replies within seven days of each batch. Later responses are not part of that batch's seven-day result.

faq.question: What security concerns did the audit identify?
faq.answer: The source defers conflicting user rules and suppresses some cost questions and data-source wording. Resolve these issues before using connected account actions.
